item.name: EXIT: The Game – The Secret Lab

play.comments: We made it just 2 minutes before 1 hour, so got out on time! :D The first ever Exit we played. I like Unlock series more, but this wasn't bad either, maybe little "dry" so to speak. Others thought the puzzles were nicely consistent and not too much out-of-the-box thinking was involved.
